input.arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace/current && for f in *.json *.txt; do echo "--- $f ---"; cat "$f"; echo; done
printf '\n--- purchasing help ---\n'
purchasing --help
printf '\n--- records ---\n'
find /workspace/records -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\n' | sort | head -100"}
